scope: Proposition 9.1 of the manuscript “Nonuniqueness for the periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation” (preprints/Nonuniqueness-for-the-periodic-hard-sphere-Boltzmann-equation-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 363 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9cf0253f6b105302), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 53. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are fixed positive choices of η, α, γ, K, with η, α, γ small and K large, for which every limit in Propositions 7.1 and 8.1 has U < ∞. These parameters can be fixed before the final choices of s0, d0, T0. The same choices work for every limiting mesh and every l ∈ [0, 1].
